name: Popliteus Tendinopathy / Injury
definition: Painful overuse or injury of the popliteus muscle-tendon unit, contributing to posterolateral knee pain and rotational control.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; MRI is used when structural injury or associated ligament damage is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent instability symptoms require reassessment for PLC injury.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Snayu posterolateral phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Painful overuse or injury of the popliteus muscle-tendon unit, contributing to posterolateral knee pain and rotational control.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
